setup_checklist_for_this_update: 1. Open the already-live 'Bar Mgmt — Feedback Notify' workflow in n8n (do not create a second workflow).

2. Add 3 new nodes: 'Has Screenshot?' (IF, boolean check on hasScreenshot), 'Decode Screenshot' (Code), 'Telegram — Send Screenshot' (Telegram, resource=message, operation=sendPhoto, binaryPropertyName=data, caption={{$json.message}}) — or simplest: delete the whole workflow and re-import this file fresh, because the credential is already set up and n8n will just ask you to re-select it for the new nodes.
2b. Update the 'Format Message' node's code to the new version in this file (adds screenshotDataUrl/hasScreenshot passthrough) — required for the IF node to have something to check.
3. Rewire: Format Message to Has Screenshot? then, if true, Decode Screenshot to Telegram Send Screenshot to Respond 200; if false, Telegram — Notify Joan (existing node, left as-is) to Respond 200.
4. On 'Telegram — Send Screenshot', assign the same 'Bar Mgmt Telegram bot' credential already working on the text node.

6. Test: submit feedback in the app WITH a pasted screenshot to confirm the photo arrives in Telegram with the caption. Then submit one WITHOUT a screenshot to confirm the old text-only behavior still works exactly as before.
7. Delete both test feedback items afterward (same DB-script pattern used throughout this project).
